messages:
marco: Heads up — running partner badge + microsite dry-run tomorrow 10am PT. Need confirmations: HW partner logos approved, SI integration link tests green, press embargo window locked. Can you confirm?
elaine: I can sync with press ops. @taylor — can you confirm embargo window? Also need blog hero approved by noon.
taylor: Embargo confirmed for Wed 11:00 PT. Will share embargo list to the thread by EOD. :lock:
samir: SI smoke tests scheduled tomorrow 8:30am PT. I need the staging creds from partner. @marco can you get them?
marco: Requested creds — partner said they'll DM by 5pm. Also, noted logo variations: full-color + mono + 32px favicons. @jenna can you verify assets?
jenna: Received logo pack v3, running checks. Quick QA checklist: contrast, padding, SVG vs PNG, filename conventions. I'll flag any fails here.
opsbot: Reminder: microsite cache invalidation window is 10:45am PT. CI deploy scheduled 9:50am PT. Use `/deploy prod microsite --tag partner-release` to trigger.
samir: For SI test harness, share endpoint: https://staging-api.redwood-inference.internal/partner/sync - use token PARTNER-STG-XXX. (I'll rotate after tests.)
elaine: Landing page copy ready in draft: short hero, 3 bullets (what, benefits, how to get started), CTA to request demo + link to marketplace listing. I'll post PR in docs repo.
marco: Press checklist quick: embargo list, quote from partner (from legal OK), hero screenshot, partner badge placement (top right) — need signoff by noon tomorrow.
jenna: Design note: badge placed at 56px from top-right on desktop, 16px on mobile. I'll attach preview in #design but here's CSS snippet: `position: absolute; top: 56px; right: 40px;`
taylor: I'll draft the press email and coordinate outlets. Also asking PR firm for embargo compliance. cc @elaine.
marco: If all green, plan: dry-run deploy 9:50am, cache invalidate 10:45am, press queue open 11:00am. Any blockers?
samir: If creds not in time, we can mock endpoint for dry-run. Prefer real SI test though.
elaine: I'll follow up with partner legal about quote by 3pm.
jenna: Found one missing fav icon size (32px). Pinging partner designer (alex).
alex: Got it — sending 32px and 16px PNGs now, also resaving svg with proper viewBox.
marco: Great — thanks everyone. I'll run the partner dry-run playbook and post a short recap in this thread after the 11am checkpoint. ✅
